title: Petal Path
features: Client accounts with two tiers (group programme, 1:1 coaching) plus a rolling membership
Date-based weekly unlocks counted from first login (24 weeks, six 4-week blocks); membership unlocks everything on day 1
Dashboard: this week, today's habits, new unlocks
Weekly lesson videos, tasks and a PDF resource library
Habit tracker with a coach habit library plus client-added habits
Six-petal flower progress model that fills as habits are completed and never goes backwards
Block check-in forms and a 1:1 onboarding form
Activity logging by hand and synced from Apple Health / Health Connect (simulated)
Coach view: every client, progress, check-ins, renewal dates, quiet clients, month 5 alerts, retain or revoke access
Body and food tracking with nutrition targets (1:1 tier)
Calm, low-clutter design: big buttons, one main action per screen

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 5 tabs in this order, rounded outline icons 24px with 13px labels. Active tab in accentFill with a small tint pill behind the icon; inactive in text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top header: 20px edge padding, screen title in display font left, one optional round icon button right.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: full-width pill, 56px tall, accentFill bg, white 16/600 label, pressed = accentPressed, disabled = border bg + tertiary text. Secondary button: pill, 1.5px borderStrong outline, text.primary label. Input: 12px radius, 52px tall, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, accentTint bg, accentFill 13px label.

screens.name: welcome
screens.purpose: Sign in and see which plan you are on
screens.content: Calm hero photo of a woman stretching on a yoga mat in soft morning light at home, app name Petal Path, tagline 'Small steps. Steady growth.', email field, one big Sign in pill button, small text link 'New here? Start onboarding'. Three plan pills under the hero: Group programme, 1:1 Coaching, Membership.

screens.name: home
screens.purpose: See this week, today's habits and new unlocks
screens.content: Greeting 'Good morning, Maya' with tier chip '1:1 Coaching'. Focal hero card with gradient: 'Week 7 of 24 - Block 2: Energy', progress bar 3 of 7 days. Section 'Today's habits' with 3 big rows with round check buttons: 'Drink 2L of water' (done), '10 minute walk' (done), 'Protein at breakfast' (to do). Section 'New this week' with 2 unlock cards: lesson video 'Planning meals when your brain is busy' with thumbnail photo and 'Block 2 check-in is open'. One main action: 'Open this week' pill.

screens.name: learn-week
screens.purpose: Weekly lesson videos, tasks and resources
screens.content: Week selector chips Week 5, 6, 7 (current, active), 8 and 9 shown with lock icon and 'Unlocks Mon 17 Nov'. Focal card: lesson video thumbnail photo of a woman journaling at a kitchen table, play button, 'Lesson 7: Routines that bend, not break - 12 min'. Tasks list with checkboxes: 'Write your 3 non-negotiables', 'Set one phone reminder'. Resources list: PDF rows 'Week 7 workbook (PDF, 4 pages)', 'Easy protein swaps (PDF)'.

screens.name: lesson-detail
screens.purpose: Watch a lesson and tick off its tasks
screens.content: Back arrow header 'Week 7'. 16:9 video player with real photo poster of a coach talking to camera in a bright studio, play button, 12:04 duration and progress scrubber. Title 'Routines that bend, not break'. Short summary paragraph. Task checklist (2 items). Downloadable PDF row. One big primary button 'Mark lesson complete'.

screens.name: habits
screens.content: Date strip Mon-Sun with today highlighted. Focal counter '3 of 5 done today' large numeral with small petal icon. Habit rows as big cards with round check buttons: 'Drink 2L of water' (coach, done), '10 minute walk' (coach, done), 'Protein at breakfast' (coach), 'Lights out by 10:30' (mine, done), 'Stretch 5 minutes' (mine). Each row shows a small source chip 'From coach' or 'Mine' and a 7-day streak dots line. One main action: 'Add a habit' pill.

screens.name: habit-library
screens.purpose: Pick habits from the coach library or create your own
screens.content: Sheet-style screen with close icon, title 'Add a habit'. Category chips: Movement, Food, Sleep, Calm. Library rows with plus buttons: 'Eat a portion of veg with lunch', 'Step outside before 10am', 'Phone out of the bedroom', 'Two-minute breathing break'. Divider 'Or create your own' with text input 'Habit name' and day chips Mon-Sun. One primary button 'Save habit'.

screens.name: progress-flower
screens.purpose: See growth as a six-petal flower
screens.content: Focal element: large flat 2D flower with 6 petals, one per block, petals 1 fully filled in accent, petal 2 filled 60%, petals 3-6 outline only, centre text 'Block 2'. Caption 'Your flower only grows. Missed days never take a petal away.' Below: stats row '41 habits done', '7 weeks', '3 check-ins'. Segmented control 'Flower | Activity'. Card 'Habits this week' small bar chart Mon-Sun.

screens.name: activity-log
screens.purpose: Log activity by hand or sync from the health app
screens.content: Focal card: today's steps '6,842' big numeral with ring toward 8,000 goal. Button row: 'Sync health data' secondary pill with heart icon, 'Last synced 08:12'. Activity list: 'Walk - 32 min - Synced', 'Strength session - 40 min - Logged by hand', 'Yoga - 20 min - Synced'. Body card: weight 68.4 kg, waist 78 cm. Food card: 'Protein 92 / 110 g' progress bar. One main action: 'Log activity' pill.

screens.name: check-in
screens.content: Header 'Block 2 check-in' with step '2 of 4' progress bar. Question 'How has your energy been this block?' with 5 big emoji-free option buttons from 'Very low' to 'Great', option 'Steady' selected. Question 'What got in the way?' multi-line input with sample text. Slider 'Sleep quality' 1-10 at 7. One primary button 'Next'.

screens.name: coach-clients
screens.purpose: Coach sees every client and acts on alerts
screens.content: Header 'Clients' with back arrow and search. Filter chips: All 28, Quiet 3, Month 5 4, Check-ins due 5. Focal alert card in warning tint: '4 clients reach month 5 this week - plan renewals'. Client rows with real photo avatars: 'Maya Collins - 1:1 - Week 7 - check-in submitted', 'Priya Shah - Group - Week 19 - Month 5 alert - renews 2 Dec', 'Hannah Lee - Group - Week 4 - Quiet 9 days', 'Zoe Martin - Membership - active'. Each row has a small mini flower progress icon and a chevron. Row action buttons Retain and Revoke on the selected row.

screens.name: profile
screens.content: Avatar real photo of a smiling woman in her thirties, name Maya Collins, chip '1:1 Coaching - renews 12 Jan'. Focal card 'Nutrition targets': 1,850 kcal, Protein 110 g, Fibre 25 g. Settings rows: 'Onboarding form - completed', 'Reminders - 08:00 and 19:30' with toggles for 'Habit reminders', 'New unlocks', 'Check-ins'. Row 'Health data - Connected' and 'Privacy and my data'. Row 'Coach view' with shield icon.

screens.name: home-empty
screens.purpose: First login, nothing unlocked yet besides week 1
screens.content: Greeting 'Welcome, Maya' with chip 'Group programme'. Focal card: real photo of a single seedling in a pot on a sunny windowsill, 'Week 1 starts today. One small step is enough.' Empty habits area: 'No habits yet' with text 'Pick your first habit to start your flower.' One primary button 'Choose my first habit'.

designSystem.a11y: white labels only on accentFill; tap targets >= 44pt; text on gradient >= 4.5:1

results.pair: accentFill as link text on background
warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
danger text on its tint and on surface
info text on its tint and on surface
support as chart line / icon on surface (non-text 3:1)
